source_file: stasis-combat-fx-v2.html (owner-supplied "STASIS 02 — Miniature Plasma Lab", kept local, not distributed)
owner_call: fireBurst('bolt', { origin, direction, count: 4, frequency: 8, scale: 0.24, freezeAt: 7.5 })
owner_clarification: one for one: each native laser projectile is one bolt at scale 0.24, travelling with the projectile
assets: none: the source is procedural (no textures); nothing was decoded or copied as a file

PLASMA_VERTEX / PLASMA_FRAGMENT.use: the ray march statement for statement; the camera (uCameraLocal) and phase (uPhase) become per-instance varyings, the output is converted to linear light with alpha 0

PARTICLE_VERTEX / PARTICLE_FRAGMENT kind.use: the glow particle's shading on camera-facing quads; point size clamp (1 px minimum) kept

FxParticles.update.use: its 1/60 s step law (damping, gravity, position) summed in closed form: particleOffset

FxPlasmaVolume.use: proxy box (length, 3.5 radius, 3.5 radius), colours 0xff202d / 0xffe3d0, steps 28 (quality high), roughness 0.4, additive, back faces, no depth write

shootBolt / _emitBurst (bolt).use: length 3.15 x scale, radius max(0.014, 0.115 x scale), power 1; uPhase = random x 40

_updateBolts.use: glow sparks: 45 per second while flying, on the bolt (half length along, one radius across), drift (direction.x x +-0.4, +-0.35, +-0.35), life 0.04-0.13 s, size 0.007-0.019, colour [1, 0.055, 0.08]

_impact('bolt') / _ring.use: floor(30 x sqrt(scale)) = 14 particles, speed (1.5..6) x sqrt(scale) along the normal plus (+-1.5, 0..2.5 up, +-2), size (0.025..0.085) x scale, life 0.3-0.8 s, gravity 6, drag 1, colour [1, 0.08, 0.075]; ring 0xff4158, 0.94-1 radius band, life 0.45 s, radius 0.1 + u x 1.1 x scale, opacity (1 - u) x 0.45

not_taken.count / frequency (PulseSequence): one bolt per native projectile (owner's clarification); the game fires the shots
not_taken.freezeAt 7.5 (BoltMotion): a travel distance in metres where a bolt stops and hangs; here the bolt must travel with the projectile
not_taken.PointLight per bolt: the laser keeps its native EF_DIMLIGHT
not_taken.stage floor bounce of particles: the level has no such plane

scale: one source unit (metre) = 24 Quake units, as the Fireball, smoke trails and shotgun pellets: bolt 18.1 units long (native laser.mdl 19.2)
